fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 14 ft Lund aluminum boat with trailer.
findings: Dull, faded dark blue paint along the port and starboard topsides, with blotchy uneven sheen visible near the bow
Hazy, mottled bare aluminum on the lower hull below the rub strip, especially at the bow
Dusty, scuffed light blue interior paint and dirt on the floor area
Dull, oxidized aluminum gunwale trim and rub rail
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund S-14. The dark blue sides look a bit faded and blotchy near the bow, and the bare aluminum below the rub strip looks hazy in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a buff and polish of the paint and aluminum, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
